claims.qualifiers: She acknowledges she has no proof and presents this as her perspective.

claims.assertion: Mari says at least six planetary resets erased advanced civilizations, after which surviving histories were reframed through imposed cosmologies.

claims.qualifiers: She attributes this claim to her data and describes the documents as control narratives.
